mapper.select: SELECT * FROM board_todo_reminders WHERE todo_id = #{value} ORDER BY scheduled_at, reminder_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_todo_reminders (todo_id, scheduled_at, status) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE board_todo_reminders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE todo_id = #{value} AND status = 'PENDING'
